final_answer: The main mechanism behind the transformer architecture, as explained in 'Explainable AI: Context-Aware Layer-Wise Integrated Gradients for Explaining Transformer Models', is the Context-Aware Layer-wise Integrated Gradients (CA-LIG) Framework. This framework computes layer-wise Integrated Gradients within each Transformer block and fuses these token-level attributions with class-specific attention gradients to provide a more comprehensive, context-aware, and reliable explanation of Transformer decision-making. (Citation: Explainable AI: Context-Aware Layer-Wise Integrated Gradients for Explaining Transformer Models)
